import io
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from saleskit.cli import main


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_report_prints_north_south_east_totals(self):
        path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "sales.csv"
        buffer = io.StringIO()
        with patch("sys.stdout", buffer):
            exit_code = main(["report", str(path)])
        self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
        output = buffer.getvalue()
        self.assertIn("north 15 600.00", output)
        self.assertIn("south 7 315.50", output)
        self.assertIn("east 21 987.25", output)
